description: Discover and control WLED lights on your network

store.summary: Find and control the WLED lights on your Wi-Fi
store.description: ZeroLED finds every WLED controller on your network automatically (mDNS, WLED node broadcasts and peer lists) and lets you control them from the keyboard: power, brightness, colour, effect, speed and intensity, plus UDP sync send/receive. An info page shows firmware version, LED count, current draw, Wi-Fi signal, uptime and more. Devices on networks that block multicast can be added by IP.
